subject: ophthalmology
title: Diseases of the vitreous

steps.tx: **Posterior vitreous detachment** (PVD) liquefies gel with age or myopia, flashing with floaters as cortex peels from retina; Weiss ring (peripapillary glial annulus) confirms complete separation. Uncomplicated PVD reassures with retinal check, but **Shafer sign** (tobacco dust pigment over inferior vitreous) warns of retinal tear needing urgent barrage laser. Myopes, post cataract and traumatised eyes detach earlier; fellow eye screening follows tears. Vitreous syneresis precedes detachment by years asymptomatically.
steps.say: Flashes plus new shower of floaters needs same day retinal check. Tobacco dust inside means tear until lasered.

steps.tx: **Vitreous haemorrhage** blinds suddenly with floaters or red haze: proliferative diabetic retinopathy (commonest), retinal tear with vessel rupture, vein occlusion, trauma, sickle cell sea fans and subarachnoid (Terson syndrome) patterns. B scan grades when no view (detachment versus blood alone); spontaneous clearing watched in diabetics with laser once visible, while dense non clearing blood, detachment or ghost cell pressure needs pars plana vitrectomy. Sickle cell disease needs exchange caution (sickling with acidosis) and sea fan laser.
steps.say: Sudden red curtain with no view: scan it. Diabetic blood often clears; tear related blood operates.

steps.tx: Degenerative inclusions: **asteroid hyalosis** (calcium phosphate balls, unilateral elderly diabetics, moves with vitreous, vision spared) versus **synchysis scintillans** (cholesterol crystals settling inferiorly like gold snow, hypermobile). Amyloid and lymphoma infiltrate vitreous (vitritis with subretinal infiltrates, CNS linkage needing biopsy with IL-10 workup). Persistent hyperplastic primary vitreous (leukocoria with microphthalmos and elongated ciliary processes, unilateral) differs from retinoblastoma by small eye without calcification. Vitreous touch in cataract surgery invites oedema and detachment.
steps.say: Sparkling balls sparing vision in elderly diabetic is asteroid. Small eye with white pupil is PHPV, not tumour.

steps.tx: **Pars plana vitrectomy** clears blood, peels membranes, repairs detachments and samples vitritis: small gauge transconjunctival ports with tamponade (gas needing posturing and altitude warnings, or silicone oil needing later removal). Endophthalmitis needs emergent vitrectomy with intravitreal antibiotics (see uveitis wave). Gas expansion with nitrous anaesthesia or flights blinds; face down posturing closes macular holes. Proliferative vitreoretinopathy (membranes redetaching retina) grades surgical prognosis.
steps.say: Gas in eye means no flying and posture face down. Redetaching membranes grade prognosis.
